application_periods.label: Faculty of Engineering and the Built Environment

aps_rule.notes: NSC levels of achievement for the top six subjects, excluding Life Orientation (not a 20-credit subject). Some programmes also consider applicants in a lower 'testing band'. Study Opportunities 2027.

faculties: Faculty of Engineering and the Built Environment

courses.name: Accounting Bridging Course
courses.notes: Qual code SCACBC. CAO code DUDABR. Campus: Ritson (Durban). Requires an NSC with diploma entry; minimum 20 points excl. LO. Not NSFAS funded (registration, tuition, materials and residence paid by the student). Passing four subjects of this course gives an alternative entry route into the Diploma in Accounting. Technical Mathematics not listed. Limited places; applicants ranked by points.

courses.name: Bachelor of Information and Communication Technology
courses.notes: Qual code BINCT1. CAO code DU-D-BIT. Campus: Ritson (Durban). No minimum APS stated. Also requires Level 4 in at least one other designated 20-credit subject, plus two more recognised 20-credit subjects at Level 4. Duration not stated. Mathematical Literacy not accepted. Technical Mathematics not listed. Limited places; applicants ranked by points.

courses.name: Bachelor of Information and Communication Technology: Internet of Things
courses.notes: Qual code BICIOT. CAO code DU-D-IOT. Campus: Ritson (Durban). No minimum APS stated. Also requires two more recognised 20-credit subjects at Level 4. Duration not stated. Mathematical Literacy not accepted. Technical Mathematics not listed. Limited places; applicants ranked by points.

courses.name: Diploma in Accounting
courses.notes: Qual codes DIACC1 (Durban), DIACTI (PMB). CAO codes DU-D-DAT (Durban), DU-P-DAT (PMB). Campus: Ritson (Durban), Riverside (Pietermaritzburg). Applicants with 26+ points go to the three-year programme; 24-25 points are placed on the 4-year ECP. Also requires two more 20-credit subjects at Level 3 plus one recognised 20-credit subject (G7 rule). Alternative entry: pass four subjects of the DUT Accounting Bridging Course. Selection in order of merit and may include an interview. Leads towards SAIPA membership. Technical Mathematics not listed. Limited places; applicants ranked by points.

courses.name: Diploma in Accounting (Extended Curriculum Programme)
courses.notes: Qual codes DIACCF (Durban), DIACCP (PMB). CAO codes DU-D-DA4 (Durban), DU-P-DA4 (PMB). Campus: Ritson (Durban), Riverside (Pietermaritzburg). Applicants with 24-25 points are placed here; 26+ go to the three-year programme. Same subject requirements as the mainstream diploma. Selection in order of merit and may include an interview. Technical Mathematics not listed. Limited places; applicants ranked by points.

courses.name: Diploma in Business and Information Management
courses.notes: Qual codes DIBIM1 (Durban), DIBSM1 (PMB). CAO codes DU-D-BI3 (Durban), DU-P-B13 (PMB). Campus: Ritson (Durban), Riverside (Pietermaritzburg). No minimum APS stated. Mathematical Literacy accepted (Level 4); no separate APS. Also requires a pass (Level 3) in four 20-credit subjects (max one language, excl. LO). Compulsory 4-month Work Integrated Learning in third year (separate fee). Duration inferred from third-year WIL. At-risk applicants may be placed on the ECP. Technical Mathematics not listed. Limited places; applicants ranked by points.

courses.name: Diploma in Business and Information Management (Extended Curriculum Programme)

courses.name: Diploma in Internal Auditing
courses.notes: Qual code DIIAU1. CAO code DU-D-DIA. Campus: Ritson (Durban). Two NSC routes: (A) English, Mathematics Level 4, two 20-credit subjects at Level 3 plus one recognised 20-credit subject; OR (B) English, Mathematics Level 3 or Mathematical Literacy Level 5, AND Accounting Level 4, one 20-credit subject at Level 3 plus one recognised subject. Requirements list route A; Mathematical Literacy accepted only via route B (no separate APS). Points from English plus the next five best subjects. Ranked by combined score; may include an interview. No minimum APS stated. At-risk applicants may be placed on the ECP. Leads towards IIA membership. Technical Mathematics not listed. Limited places; applicants ranked by points.

courses.name: Diploma in Management Accounting
courses.notes: Qual codes DIMAC1 (Durban), DMACC1 (PMB). CAO codes DUDMAC (Durban), DUPMAC (PMB). Campus: Ritson (Durban), Riverside (Pietermaritzburg). CIMA-endorsed. No minimum APS stated. Two NSC routes: (A) English plus Mathematics Level 3 or Accounting Level 4, and three 20-credit subjects at Level 3; OR (B) English, Mathematical Literacy Level 5 AND Accounting Level 4, and two 20-credit subjects at Level 3. Mathematical Literacy accepted only via route B (no separate APS). Selection in order of merit and may include an interview; at-risk applicants may be placed on an extended programme (none listed for this diploma). Duration not stated. Technical Mathematics not listed. Limited places; applicants ranked by points.
